assets.title: Durable Execution 状态机
assets.summary: 把任务生命周期与 worker 生命周期拆开：WAITING 不占 worker，RUNNING 只是短期执行租约，恢复围绕持久 execution state 展开。
assets.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> RUNNABLE
  RUNNABLE --> RUNNING: worker lease
  RUNNING --> WAITING: timer / signal / approval
  WAITING --> RUNNABLE: event arrives
  RUNNING --> RUNNABLE: retryable failure
  RUNNING --> COMPLETED: durable result
  RUNNING --> CANCELLED: cancellation
  RUNNING --> FAILED: terminal failure
  RUNNING --> RUNNABLE: worker crash / lease expires
  COMPLETED --> [*]
  CANCELLED --> [*]
  FAILED --> [*]

assets.title: Crash Window / Side-effect Failure Matrix
assets.summary: 真正困难的不是“进程死了”，而是外部世界和本地 journal 在不同时间点看到的状态不一致。
rows: 外部已执行，本地未确认
等待期间 worker 消失

assets.title: Workspace 与 Agent / Task / Worker 的对象关系
assets.summary: Workspace 是长期工作现场；Task 引用它，Worker 临时 attach。这样计算资源才可以销毁和替换。

flowchart LR
  A[Agent Instance] -->|owns / selects| W[Persistent Workspace]
  A --> T1[Task A]
  A --> T2[Task B]
  T1 -->|uses| W
  T2 -->|uses| W
  R1[Worker 1] -. lease / attach .-> T1
  R2[Worker 2] -. resume / attach .-> T2
  W --> F[Files / repo]
  W --> E[Environment state]
  W --> B[Browser / app profile]
  W -. not necessarily .-> P[Live processes]

assets.title: Selective Eval Scheduler Pipeline
assets.summary: 候选生成与昂贵 benchmark 解耦，先用廉价信号筛选，再把预算投向高信息增益节点。

flowchart LR

  C --> S[Scheduler]
  S -->|promising / uncertain| M[Medium eval]
  M --> S
  S -->|top candidates| E[Expensive benchmark]
  E --> P{Promotion gate}
  P -->|pass| R[Version registry]
  P -->|fail| X[Reject / archive]
  S -->|budget exhausted| X

assets.title: Eval 分层与成本

rows: 小样本任务、单元/集成测试
完整 benchmark、真实 sandbox、人工审查
独立未用于搜索的数据

assets.title: Long-horizon Reflection 控制环
assets.summary: 可靠的长程改进不是无限追加聊天，而是版本化 candidate、独立 evaluate、保留 best state。
assets.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  B[Best-so-far solution] --> G[Generate improvement]
  G --> E[Evaluate]
  E --> S{Better?}
  S -->|yes| B2[Promote new best]
  B2 --> C[Consolidate state]
  C --> B
  S -->|no| R[Reject / branch / restart]
  R --> G
  E --> STOP{Stopping rule}
  STOP -->|budget / plateau| END[Return best]
